seo.title: Contact & Booking
seo.description: Book a free fifteen-minute conversation with Dr. Lauretta Ogbum, or send an enquiry. Port Harcourt by appointment, online worldwide. Replies within two working days.

hero.title: Start with a free conversation.
hero.intro: Fifteen minutes, no charge, no obligation, and nothing goes on record. You describe what is happening; I tell you honestly whether I am the right person for it — and if I am not, I will tell you who is.

form.title: Send me a message
form.intro: Everything here comes to me directly. You do not need to explain your whole situation — a sentence or two is enough to go on.
form.topicPlaceholder: Choose one — or leave it blank
form.messagePlaceholder: A sentence or two is enough. You do not need to explain everything here — that is what the conversation is for.
form.consentLabel: I’m happy for Dr. Ogbum to reply to me using the details above. Enquiries are kept confidential and are never shared or used for marketing.
form.footnote: This form is not monitored continuously and is not an emergency service. If you are at risk of harm, please use the crisis resources rather than waiting for a reply.

whatsapp.title: Prefer WhatsApp?
whatsapp.intro: Scheduling and admin only — please do not send clinical detail over WhatsApp.

practicalities.title: Practicalities
practicalities.confidentiality: Enquiries are private and never shared. Nothing you send here goes on a clinical record.

urgent.title: If your situation is urgent
urgent.intro: This practice is not an emergency service and this form is not monitored continuously. If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, at risk of harm, or thinking about suicide, please do not wait for a reply from me.
